_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): inbound webhook receiver — HMAC-SHA256 body-bound signature verification, idempotency-key replay protection, event recording + handler dispatch hook.
name: feature-webhook
description: Inbound webhook receiver: HMAC-SHA256 body verification, idempotency-key replay protection, recorded events with handler dispatch.

variables.name: secret_env
variables.description: Env var holding the shared HMAC secret

notes: After applying: 1) app.include_router(router), 2) set WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env, 3) make sure the model is imported (Base.metadata.create_all runs at app import), 4) implement per-source handlers in webhook_service.dispatch (TODO). Sender contract: POST {base_path}/webhooks/{source} with headers X-Webhook-Timestamp, X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=hex(hmac_sha256(secret, '{timestamp}.{raw_body}')), and optionally X-Idempotency-Key for replay protection. Returns 401 on bad signature, 200 with {received:true,id}.
